auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account your shop owner gave you.
auth.serverError: Could not reach the server. Try again.

owner.title: Business overview
owner.subtitle: All your shops at a glance.
owner.previewNote: Sales, cash and stock figures appear here once the point of sale and inventory are connected.
owner.noShops: No shops have been set up yet.

shop.noShop: No shop is assigned to your account. Ask the owner to give you access.
shop.posSoon: The point of sale is not available yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the app looks for everyone in your business.
settings.appNameHint: Shown in the header, on the sign-in page and in the browser tab.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Square logos look best.
settings.colorHint: Used exactly as chosen for accents. Buttons use a darker shade of it when needed, so their text stays readable.
settings.languagesHint: The languages people can choose from.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account is not set up for the shop system. Ask the owner to give you a role.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Your catalogue and stock in each shop.
products.searchPlaceholder: Scan a barcode or search by name or code
products.name: Product name
products.codeAuto: Leave empty to use the first barcode
products.barcodesHint: Scan with the barcode reader or type it, then press Enter. A barcode can belong to one product only.
products.reorderHint: A product is marked as low stock when a shop’s stock falls to its reorder level. Leave empty for none.
products.stockNote: Stock quantities change only through receiving, sales, transfers and stock counts.
